label: TP
reason: User-supplied parameter flows directly to bar via ThingFactory.createThing().doSomething(), which returns the input unchanged. The resulting bar is written to HTTP response via PrintWriter.println(bar.toCharArray()). Since charArray() does not sanitize HTML entities, unencoded user input is reflected in the browser, causing XSS.

evidence.note: Param extracted from request, passed to factory, returned as-is, printed to response
